title: Copilot Studio: share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned sharing capability and the documented workflow billing and capacity enforcement. Minor corrections should complete the capacity control's instructions, qualify the general agent-sharing limits, and remove checklist and control-gap statements that have no table row.

claims.where: controls[1].ui
claims.claim: The capacity control is reached through Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Copilot Studio > Manage Copilot Credits > environment > Copilot Credits in the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Under the Copilot Studio heading, select Manage Copilot Credits or Manage sessions. In the allocation panel, select an environment and specify the number of Copilot Credits to allocate in the Copilot Credits textbox.
claims.fix: Keep the allocation path. Add to controls[1].note: 'In the same allocation panel, under Capacity overages, select Draw from the available capacity in my tenant and/or Bill to my pay-as-you-go billing plan to configure overage sources.' The printed path reaches allocation but omits the overage controls the row also describes.

claims.where: controls[1].api
claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes environment Copilot Credit allocations and tenant-pool enforcement.
claims.quote:
$apiBaseUrl = "https://api.powerplatform.com"
$apiVersion = "2024-10-01"
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion"
claims.fix: Keep the call and add to controls[1].note: 'The request body identifies scope.environmentId and allocatedEntitlements.entitlementId MCSMessages, sets allocation.quantity, and sets enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool and enabled true or false for tenant-capacity draw. The cited tutorial does not document a pay-as-you-go enforcement property.'
